description: Send a message. Modes: direct (set "to"), channel (set "channel"), broadcast (set "broadcast":true), reply (set "reply_to"), forward (set "forward"). Only one mode at a time.

ack_required.description: Whether the recipient must acknowledge (direct only)

comment.description: Optional comment to add when forwarding

forward.description: Forward this message ID (must also set "to" or "channel")

reply_to.description: Reply to this message ID (auto-threads, auto-routes to same target)

thread_id.description: Reply to this thread (for direct/channel sends)

to.description: Recipient agent name or ID (direct message)

name: comm_send
